{{Quote|I used to swim in the icy crystal streams near my village.''"<br />"''In the mountains?''"<br />"''Yes.|Padmé Amidala and Ian Lago|<ref name="Summer's Dream">{{Tales|5|A Summer's Dream}}</ref>}}
A '''small village''' was founded in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the few last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee]] of the [[Naberrie family/Legends|House Naberrie]] and his wife [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal]] greatly helped establish that settlement, supervising both the physical construction of the village and the formation of its community.<ref name="FF80">{{FactFile|80|NAB 1-4|Jobal Naberrie}}</ref> However, the couple eventually decided to leave their beloved mountains for the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] in order to give a chance at a higher education to their young daughters, [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé]], both born in the village.<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File 84">{{FactFile|84|NAB 33-36|Naboo &ndash; Naberrie Family Home}}</ref> When Padmé became [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]], she retained only one tradition from her native village, her [[Color/Legends|white]] thumbnail polish.<ref name="TPMV" />

A rare and beautiful [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Unidentified pink flower|flower]] grew near this village. It bloomed only once every eighty-eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]], heralding a time of special celebration.<ref name="TPMV" /> While obviously rocky, this region did not feature any [[Water/Legends|waterfalls]], as Padmé had never seen one before visiting Theed for the first time.<ref name="AOTCn">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> However, several icy and clear streams flowed in the vicinity of the village, and the young Padmé enjoyed swimming in them.<ref name="Summer's Dream" />
